name: DTMAPI 箱子定位器增强
author: Yuuka
description: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。扩展官方箱子定位器共享容器范围，基于 DTMAPI ChestLocator API。

localized_description.schinese: 依赖 DTMAPI Runtime。扩展官方箱子定位器的共享容器范围，让贴了定位器的箱子和储物架纸箱在不同建筑房间也能参与制作、研究等材料路径。基于 DTMAPI ChestLocator API。
localized_description.tchinese: 依賴 DTMAPI Runtime。擴展官方箱子定位器的共享容器範圍，讓貼了定位器的箱子和儲物架紙箱在不同建築房間也能參與製作、研究等材料路徑。基於 DTMAPI ChestLocator API。
localized_description.english: Requires DTMAPI Runtime. Extends official locator-marked shared containers so chests and storage-shelf boxes across farm building rooms can participate in material lookup and consume paths. Built on the DTMAPI ChestLocator API.
